key_insight: Buoyancy-driven vibration depends strongly on array layout: the 3×3 array exhibits localized synchronization, while the 4×4 array shows only forced buffeting.
engineering_relevance: Cylinder arrangement can alter vibration risks and heat transfer in naturally cooled tube arrays and enclosed thermal systems.
method: Simulate heated cylinder arrays in a square enclosure at Pr = 7 and Ra = 10⁷.
Couple thermal flow and structural motion using a body-fitted arbitrary Lagrangian–Eulerian framework.
Use variational finite elements to compare stationary and elastically mounted arrays.
evidence_signal: The 3×3 left-column cylinders lock in with the nondimensional wall-gap plume frequency of 0.183 at reduced velocity 15.7; only the 4×4 array shows measurable array-level heat-transfer enhancement.
watch_item: Findings are reported at a single Prandtl–Rayleigh condition, so applicability to other fluids or buoyancy regimes requires validation.
paper_title: Flow-induced vibration of an array of circular cylinders in a square enclosure due to thermal buoyancy
